A historic day for FL-27 and families across America!
President Trump just signed the TAKE IT DOWN Act into law—a bill I proudly led in the House to protect our children from online predators and AI exploitation.
- - - - 
¡Día histórico para el Distrito 27 y las familias de EE.UU.!
El presidente Trump acaba de firmar la ley TAKE IT DOWN, un proyecto que lideré con orgullo en la Cámara de Representantes para proteger a nuestros niños de los depredadores en línea y del abuso con inteligencia artificial.

President Trump has officially signed my TAKE IT DOWN ACT, putting predators, platforms, and AI abusers on notice! Proud of this win for families in FL-27 and all over the USA! https://t.co/N1Jl5ecPOX

My TAKE IT DOWN ACT was created for a reason. 

That’s why I joined @amyklobuchar and @repdean in calling on the Department of Justice to prioritize compliance with our legislation following alarming reports that X’s Grok chatbot was used to generate and distribute AI-created, non-consensual sexual images.

Congress has done its job. The law is clear.

Now we must ensure the implementation of this law protects victims and holds abusers accountable.

For years, predators hid behind screens while victims were told nothing could be done. Those days are over. This conviction proves the TAKE IT DOWN Act is working. If you target women or children using this technology, you will be found, prosecuted, and locked up. No excuses.
statements.venue: Press release on first conviction under TAKE IT DOWN Act

statements.text:
Honored to be recognized tonight at the 25th Anniversary of GRAMMYs On The Hill for standing up for artists in the AI era.

Music is the heartbeat of freedom. It carries truth, identity, and the human soul. As AI reshapes the future, we must ensure it empowers creativity, never exploits it.

Proud to stand with the Recording Academy to defend the voices and creators who give culture its power.

Today, I joined @SenTedCruz, @SenKlobucharUS, and @RepDean in urging the Federal Trade Commission to enforce the TAKE IT DOWN Act.

Effective today, online platforms are required to remove non-consensual intimate images, including AI-generated content, within 48 hours of being notified. We are calling on the FTC to brief our offices on enforcement mechanisms and ensure full compliance across all platforms.

In this new era of AI, bad actors are quickly and easily profiting from the creativity of others. Our laws must catch up. [...] The NO FAKES Act is simple and sacred: you own your identity—not Big Tech, not scammers, not algorithms. Deepfakes are digital lies that ruin real lives, and it's time to fight back.
statements.venue: Press release on reintroducing NO FAKES Act

statements.text:
AI is moving fast, but our laws cannot fall behind.

That is why I’m proud to work alongside @RepDean , @MarshaBlackburn, and @ChrisCoons on the bipartisan NO FAKES Act to protect creators, artists, and everyday Americans from unauthorized digital replicas and online abuse.

Deepfakes are digital lies with real consequences. It is time for our laws to catch up.

For all the good AI can do, there has to be a line.

No one should have to worry that their face or voice can be stolen and used to deceive others.

That's why I've been pushing the bipartisan NO FAKES Act from day one. People should decide what happens to their own likeness, not Big Tech, not scammers, not anyone else.

I'm grateful to the thousands of @sagaftra members who are raising their voices on this issue. The technology is moving fast. Congress can't afford to fall behind.

https://t.co/7gPt41v9Nd

Huge step forward. 🚨Last week the NO FAKES Act passed the Senate Judiciary Committee, unanimously.

This bill is simple: your image, your voice, and your likeness belong to you. No one should be able to use AI to steal your identity, clone your voice, or make it appear you said or did something you never did.

I am proud to lead this bipartisan effort in the House alongside @RepDean and to work with senators @MarshaBlackburn and @ChrisCoons to get this bill signed into law.

Americans deserve the peace of mind of knowing they have meaningful protections in the age of AI.

AI is moving fast, and that is exciting. But no one should have to worry that their face or voice can be copied, manipulated, or used to deceive others. The NO FAKES Act is simple. Your identity belongs to you.
statements.venue: Press release on NO FAKES Act advancing in Senate Judiciary Committee

statements.text:
A fake image can be created in seconds. For a child and their family, the damage can last a lifetime.

That’s why protecting our children in the digital world has been one of my priorities in Congress.

I authored the House version of the TAKE IT DOWN Act and helped turn it into law, giving victims new protections against non-consensual intimate images and AI-generated deepfakes.

Our children deserve to be protected online just as fiercely as we protect them everywhere else.

Great visit with the Citi team in Miami today!

We talked about banking, AI, innovation, and how we keep our economy growing.

Miami is becoming one of America’s most important centers for finance and investment, while remaining our gateway to Latin America.

As a member of the House Financial Services Committee, I always value hearing directly from the people doing the work and investing in our community.

Thank you to Woodward Middleton and the entire Citi team for the warm welcome!
